title: The Debt of the DMZ Again
author: Silas Coldharbour
blurb: Felix Quintana, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
